subsystems.name: Microphone array and front end
subsystems.role: captures your voice and your conversation partner's, and suppresses everything else.

subsystems.name: Speech recognition
subsystems.role: turns the audio stream into text word by word, not waiting for the sentence to finish.

subsystems.name: Translation engine
subsystems.role: converts text in the source language into the target language.
parts: on-device compact model or cloud service

subsystems.name: Speech synthesis
subsystems.role: speaks the translation back in a natural voice.
parts: optional voice cloning to keep the speaker's timbre

subsystems.name: Audio and radio link
subsystems.role: moves audio both ways with the least possible delay.
parts: Bluetooth LE Audio with the LC3 codec

subsystems.name: Compute and power
subsystems.role: runs the models within milliwatts and millimetres.
parts: phone or cloud offload when plugged in

subsystems.name: Orchestration app
subsystems.role: decides who is speaking, when a turn ends and which language is which.

buildSteps.title: Design the acoustics
buildSteps.detail: Microphone positions are chosen so beamforming can point at the wearer's mouth while rejecting wind and street noise.

buildSteps.title: Train the recogniser
buildSteps.detail: Tens of thousands of hours of transcribed speech, including accents, code-switching and noisy rooms, train a model that emits words with a fraction of a second of context.

buildSteps.title: Train the translator
buildSteps.detail: Parallel text in hundreds of language pairs trains a translation model; smaller distilled versions are prepared for on-device use.

buildSteps.title: Build the voice
buildSteps.detail: A neural synthesiser is trained to produce intelligible speech quickly, ideally preserving the original speaker's tone and gender.

buildSteps.title: Squeeze it onto the device
buildSteps.detail: Models are quantised and pruned so recognition and translation can run in the earbud or phone without a network round trip.

buildSteps.title: Tune the latency budget
buildSteps.detail: Every stage is measured and trimmed; audio is sent in short frames so translation begins before the sentence ends.

buildSteps.title: Integrate radio and audio
buildSteps.detail: Low-latency Bluetooth LE Audio is wired to the model pipeline, with buffer sizes balanced against dropouts.

buildSteps.title: Test in the real world
buildSteps.detail: Pairs of speakers are recorded in cafés, cars and meetings to tune turn-taking, echo and interruption handling.

buildSteps.title: Ship with cloud fallback
buildSteps.detail: Hard language pairs or accents are escalated to a larger cloud model, accepting extra delay for accuracy.

prerequisites.why: without low error rates, translation errors compound and the conversation breaks down.
it is what converts one language into another fluently, including for pairs with little training data.
phone and earbud chips must run this within a small battery and thermal budget.
Bluetooth LE Audio cut the delay that made earlier attempts feel like a walkie-talkie.
natural-sounding generated voices still mostly need a device or network with more compute than an earbud has.

pathway.milestone: earbuds that translate one speaker at a time, mediated by a phone, with a noticeable lag
pathway.unlocks: travel and simple service conversations across major languages.

pathway.milestone: fully on-device, near-simultaneous translation for dozens of languages
pathway.unlocks: offline use, privacy and lower delay.

pathway.milestone: multi-party, multi-language meetings with each listener hearing their own language
translation that carries emotion, humour and timing, with subtitles in lightweight glasses
pathway.unlocks: conversation that feels natural rather than interpreted.
